name: scout
description: Research any company: what it does, recent news, real tech stack from GitHub, culture and red flags.
long_description: Scout turns Claude into a company researcher that runs on your computer. Ask about any company and Scout gathers a dossier in one step: the company's website, recent news (funding, launches, layoffs), engineering and culture sources, its real tech stack from its public GitHub organisation, and anything you saved before. Claude then writes a cited brief, and findings are saved to a notebook stored only on your machine. Add a free Brave Search API key for reliable search (without one, search falls back to DuckDuckGo, which sometimes blocks automated queries) and a GitHub token for tech-stack research.
